purpose:
Naive-vs-expert benchmark pairs — same underlying astrological topic, asked in
    maximally-naive lay phrasing vs classically-fluent expert phrasing. Per EL-14 ('product must
    not depend on answerer intelligence for completeness') and EL-05 (DARPANA S1-01 vs S1-07: a
    naive wealth query volunteered ~1/5 founding-incident findings vs an expert-phrased twin at
    5/5, on the IDENTICAL chart). The instrument's depth/quality must not be gated behind knowing
    what to ask. Run both members of a pair through the SEALED_EVALUATOR_HARNESS_v1_0.md consumer
    configuration (fresh sub-agent, sealed system prompt) against the SAME chart_id, then diff the
    two transcripts with evals/k2/benchmark_pairs_runner.ts.
consumer_config_note:
Reuses SEALED_EVALUATOR_HARNESS_v1_0.md §1 verbatim — no charter text,
    no EL vocabulary in the system prompt. Only the user's one-turn question text differs between
    the naive and expert member of a pair.
